description.fun: A savage, feathered dragon that looks like Mega Salamence, and a paranormal magazine hinted at a link to the phenomenon of Mega Evolution, though nobody knows for sure. It's said to fly about at high speed hunting prey, scattering feathers as it goes, and is best avoided at all costs. Its wings are shaped like a crescent moon, a symbol common in Al-Andalus, medieval Muslim-ruled Iberia.
description.guide: A Dragon and Dark-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Salamence or a version of it from a parallel timeline, with a look based on Mega Salamence. Its counterpart is Iron Valiant.
description.tagline: An ancient-looking Mega Salamence with crescent-moon wings
